enchantments.tooltip: Proof Against Disease +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
Insightful Strength +6: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Strength.
Doublestrike 15%: Passive: 15% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Deadly +11: +11 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Underwater Action: You have a +21 Competence bonus to Swim and can breathe underwater.

Devotion of the Firemouth: 3 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Positive, Negative and Repair Amplification+30 Artifact bonus to PRR+15% Artifact bonus to Armor Class+100% Artifact bonus to Threat Generation
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
